items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: Because I was playing with Son Wilson then... He had, he had me, him, and this guy, Noonie, on piano.

ctx.x: Who were some of the piano players around when you were coming up?

The piano players? This boy here, Noonie. Noonie Perez, who was a, Bauhaus piano player. Because I was playing with Son Wilson then, trumpet player and that was, he's a piano player. And they real tunk, you know what I mean? Yeah, I know. Real tunk, yeah, yeah. I know from, and Simon, Simon, Boynel San Diego, Black San Diego, Mitchell Frazier.
Was he any kind of Simon?
